method: Person-level resource-band to next-month valid numeric TPEARN/TMWKHRS change, conditioned on EDISABL, using WPFINWGT and Census Fay BRR with G=240 and perturbation factor 0.5.
boundary: Primary and replicate files remain outside Git. Earnings and hours have separate valid pair universes; neither field establishes desired hours, job quality, accommodation, household prevalence, causality, or downstream meaning/action.
